breve: A scalar integer function to be used within the visual shader graph.
descricao: Accept an integer scalar (x) to the input port and transform it according to 'function'.

propriedades.desc: A function to be applied to the scalar.

constantes.desc: Returns the absolute value of the parameter. Translates to abs(x) in the Godot Shader Language.
Extracts the sign of the parameter. Translates to sign(x) in the Godot Shader Language.
Returns the result of bitwise NOT operation on the integer. Translates to ~a in the Godot Shader Language.
Represents the size of the 'Function' enum.
